{"parentUuid":"64d63ccc-34ac-4e62-b877-d516b162e25c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfuCt9r6EreHm5oCs8kn4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01RVXcu26BcDRV3TsX8fceez","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-maximo-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/9bedde74-7160-4dff-9700-957083ce192b/scratchpad && cat > $S/t02-review.md <<'EOF'\n## `/code-review` findings for T02, and how each was resolved\n\nTwo-axis review (`mattpocock-skills:code-review`) of the working tree against `f9475b7`. A separate sub-agent ran each axis. After the fixes: **94 tests pass**, and mypy reports no issues in `app/`, the seed, or the T01/T02 test files it checked. `tests/conftest.py` still shows the 5 mypy errors in T01's `routes` fixture that were already there at `f9475b7`; this ticket added none.\n\n### Standards\n\nNo hard violations. Checked: CSRF on every new POST form (save, *Vista previa*, delete), Markdown sanitized before `|safe`, no new dependency, no secrets, `site/` untouched, every file under 500 lines, no commented-out code.\n\n| # | Finding | Kind | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| S1 | `markdown.to_html` kept root-absolute links (`[a](/admin)`, `//elsewhere`). Once the export uses it, that breaks \"Published HTML uses relative paths only\" (CLAUDE.md, rubric F2) | documented standard, at risk | **Fixed, test first.** nh3 `url_relative=\"deny\"`: links keep only full `http(s)`/`mailto` addresses. `test_vista_previa_drops_root_absolute_links_so_published_html_stays_relative`. |\n| S2 | `_check` reuses the glossary's \"check\" (the leader's review); `editor()` reuses the *editor* role | judgement call: Mysterious Name / glossary | **Fixed.** Renamed to `_validate` and `render_post_form`. |\n| S3 | *Enlace* (slug) and *Vista previa* had no glossary entry | judgement call (domain.md) | **Fixed.** Added **Slug** (*Enlace*) and **Preview** (*Vista previa*) to `CONTEXT.md`. |\n| S4 | Post status is a bare string in the schema, `STATUS_NAMES`, the INSERT and Policy | judgement call: Primitive Obsession | **Deferred to T03** (#4). In T02, save and delete never change a status; T03 brings the first transition (publish), and the `Status` type belongs with that transition table. (T01's role finding was deferred the same way.) |\n| S5 | New vs. existing post: `if post` branches in the editor template; similar create/save and preview routes | judgement call: Repeated Switches / Duplicated Code | **Partly fixed.** The heading is set once. The rest stays: create and save call different Content functions with different messages, and each preview route is one line. |\n| S6 | The meta line was copied between the editor and the read-only view | judgement call: Duplicated Code | **Fixed.** Both now include `admin/_post_meta.html`. |\n| S7 | Test files imported helpers from other test files; the logout filter was repeated | judgement call | **Fixed.** `cells`, `env_example` and `run_seed` are now \"return a function\" fixtures in `conftest.py` (T01's tests use them too), and `form_actions` drops the Salir form itself. |\n| S8 | Two tests set a post's status with SQL instead of HTTP | judgement call (spec Testing Decisions) | **Kept.** This follows T01, which set `active = 0` in storage. One helper, `set_every_post_status`, does it, and its comment names T03/T04 as the tickets whose buttons replace it. |\n| S9 | The `slugify` docstring hard-coded 80; the fallback `or SLUG_FALLBACK` was repeated | low | **Fixed.** The docstring refers to `SLUG_MAX`, and the fallback now lives inside `slugify`. |\n\n### Spec\n\nAll nine acceptance criteria of #3 are met, each by a test named after it. No scope creep found.\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| P1 | \"The post lifecycle as an explicit set of transitions… refused here, not in the routes\": `content.save_post` and `delete_post` accept any status | **Kept, with reasons.** In T02, save and delete never change a status, so Content has no transition to refuse yet. The spec gives \"may this person do this action to this item? … from role, ownership and status\" to Policy, and `policy.may_change_post` is where that check lives. T03 (#4) adds the first status transitions to Content. T05 (#6) splits Save from Delete when *Propose edit* arrives. |\n| P2 | \"The leader can edit any post\" was tested only on a member's draft | **Fixed.** `test_leader_edits_any_post_whatever_its_status` (submitted and published). |\n| P3 | `GET /admin/posts/abc` returned 422 as English JSON (against \"every error shows a message\", \"unknown ids get 404\") | **Fixed, test first.** A non-numeric id is treated as unknown: the Spanish 404 page, with the admin menu. |\n| P4 | \"Every write route asks [Policy]\": creating a post doesn't | **Kept.** It does ask: `signed_in_user` calls `policy.may_use_route` on every admin route, `create_post` included, and every signed-in person may write a post. A separate always-true function would be Speculative Generality. |\n| P5 | A taken manual slug became `uno-2` with no word to the person | **Fixed, test first.** The save message says so: *\"El enlace «uno» ya era de otra publicación: quedó «uno-2».\"* |\n| P6 | The leader saw *Guardar borrador* on non-drafts; the help text \"hasta que la publicación se publique\" echoes itself | **Fixed.** The button reads *Guardar cambios* on a post that isn't a draft; the help text is reworded; `CONTEXT.md` now notes that *publicación* is always the thing, never the act of publishing. |\n\n**Summary:** 9 Standards findings (the worst is S1, root-absolute links that would break the export's relative paths; fixed) and 6 Spec findings (the worst is P1, lifecycle transitions not in Content; kept for T02 with reasons, and T03 picks it up).\nEOF\ngh issue comment 3 --body-file $S/t02-review.md","description":"Post review findings and resolutions on issue #3"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1105,"cache_read_input_tokens":257489,"output_tokens":3470,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":1216},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1105,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3470,"cache_read_input_tokens":257489,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1105,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1105},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01RVXcu26BcDRV3TsX8fceez":{"command":"cd /Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-maximo-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/9bedde74-7160-4dff-9700-957083ce192b/scratchpad && cat > $S/t02-review.md <<'EOF'\n## `/code-review` findings for T02, and how each was resolved\n\nTwo-axis review (`mattpocock-skills:code-review`) of the working tree against `f9475b7`. {"parentUuid":"cad37d98-f8c1-4909-8f5f-84b1c8bd6351","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfuCwCkHmKQ2AEesBcX2J","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've built T02 (#3) and committed it to `main` as `ab8e866`. I haven't pushed it, so #3 will close when you push. All 94 tests pass (47 before this ticket), and the new code passes mypy.\n\n**What members and the leader can now do:**\n- **Write and save a draft:** a member writes a post with a title, one of the five topics and a Markdown body, and saves it. The **Publicaciones** list shows every post with its title, topic, nickname, status and last update (in Monterrey time).\n- **Slugs:** each post gets a slug made from its title, keeping accents and ñ (`crónica-del-clásico-regio`). A taken slug gets `-2`, `-3`. A slug typed by hand is checked, and an invalid one is refused with a message.\n- **Vista previa:** shows the cleaned-up result below the form without saving. Scripts, `onerror=`-style attributes, `javascript:` links and images are removed.\n- **Who can change what:** a member changes only their own drafts. Other people's posts open read-only, and a direct POST to save or delete someone else's post gets a 403 with the reason in Spanish. The leader can edit and delete any post.\n- **Deleting** asks for confirmation on a separate page first. Every save, delete and error shows a message.\n- **Seed:** it now adds one draft written by Rayada de Corazón.\n\n**Choices you may want to check:**\n- **Spanish words:** I used *Publicación* (your pick) and added it to `CONTEXT.md`. I also added *Borrador*, *Enviada*, *Publicada*, *Enlace* and *Vista previa*, plus a note that *publicación* is the post itself, never the act of publishing.\n- **Taken hand-typed slugs:** I read the spec's \"same rules\" to mean they get `-2` too. The save message tells the person their link was changed.\n- **Slug lock:** the slug becomes fixed after first publication. I left that to T03, whose acceptance criteria include it.\n- **Testing statuses:** submitting and publishing don't exist yet, so two tests set a post's status directly in the database. T01 did the same for deactivating an account.\n\n**Review:** I ran the two-way code review and posted the findings and what I did about each on #3 ([comment](https://github.com/maxillamas06-arch/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/3#issuecomment-6101975796)). Changes it led to:\n- Links in posts must now be full addresses. Links like `/admin` would have broken the public site's relative-paths rule once the export uses the same Markdown code.\n- An id like `/admin/posts/abc` returned a 422 error in English JSON; it now gets the Spanish not-found page.\n- The leader now sees *Guardar cambios* instead of *Guardar borrador* on a post that isn't a draft.\n- Shared test helpers now live in `conftest.py`, including two that were in T01's test files.\n\nWhere I disagreed with the review, with reasons in the comment:\n- **Status rules in Content:** in T02, saving and deleting never change a post's status, so Content has nothing to refuse yet. Who may act is Policy's job, and Policy already checks it. The status rules, and a proper status type, belong with T03's first status change.\n- **\"Create doesn't ask Policy\":** it does. The sign-in check asks Policy on every admin page, including creating a post.\n\n**Things to know:**\n- Your local `.env` sets the site title to *Knox County Historical Society*, probably left over from the starter template. `.env.example` is correct and `.env` isn't committed, so this only affects what you see in the admin console when you run it yourself.\n- `tests/conftest.py` already had 5 mypy errors in the `routes` fixture before this ticket.
